title: Buon Ma Thuot in a day
summary: Khải Đoan and the prison in town, then Dray Nur on the Serepok in the afternoon.

stops.name: Khai Doan Pagoda
stops.note: The wooden hall, the lantern stair, and the white pavilion. Late morning or afternoon light on the roof.

stops.name: Buon Ma Thuot Prison
stops.note: The yellow French-built compound at 18 Tan Thuat. Morning is the easier hour.

stops.name: Dray Nur Waterfall
stops.note: A 250 m curtain on the Serepok, about 25 to 30 km south. Swim only where the staff allow it.

seoTitle: Buon Ma Thuot in a day
seoDescription: One day from Khải Đoan pagoda and the old prison on Tan Thuat to Dray Nur, the 250 m waterfall on the Serepok about 25 to 30 km south.
